description: This is a BitBake include (.inc) file used to define the build configuration, dependencies, packaging, and installation scripts for the GLib 2.0 library in the Yocto Project build system.

classes.name: glib
classes.description: Build configuration and metadata for the GLib library, including dependencies, packaging, installation, and license details.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Prepares the build environment by modifying configuration files, for example, by editing gdbus-codegen.in to use the correct interpreter.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Performs installation tasks such as removing unnecessary files, fixing file naming for multilib systems, and creating necessary directories.

methods.name: do_install:append
methods.description: Additional target-specific installation steps, such as removing test files based on build options.

methods.name: do_install:append:mingw32
methods.description: Specific cleanup for MinGW cross-compile targets, such as removing scripts that depend on Python 3 which isn't built for Windows.
